source.text: We postponed unattended ingestion from the Harbor API because version2 cannot resume a download after a disconnected connection. Manual ingestion remains the plan.

source.speaker: Blair
source.text: Harbor API version3 now provides continuation tokens for interrupted downloads. In a fault-injection test, the client resumed from the token after the connection was cut and completed the download.

source.text: We rejected deployment of the Atlas classifier to the 8 GB field device because its original model requires 32 GB of memory. Deployment also requires at least 90 percent accuracy.

source.text: The quantized Atlas model uses 6.2 GB on the same 8 GB field device. The held-out accuracy of that quantized model is 92 percent.
